source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: Two courses share these photos and no hole map was found; the hole order is my best guess from the card's lengths. Holes 3 to 9 fit the card well; 1, 2 and 10 to 18 are less certain.
unsure.1: Card says par 5, 500 yd, but the only hole that starts at the clubhouse here is about 315 yd; it may be a different green or the hole was changed.
unsure.9: Card says par 5, 555 yd; the strip from the canal to the green by the clubhouse is only about 400 yd.
unsure.12: Plays down the same lake-side corridor as 17 in the other direction; which hole uses which side is a guess.
unsure.13: Par 3 traced about 120 yd against the card's 193; tee spot guessed between the two lakes.
unsure.17: Placed back up the diagonal corridor to the green by the road; corridor shared with 12.
unsure.18: Tee placed by the road near 17's green; plays up the diagonal between the lakes to the green next to the clubhouse.
unsure.11: Tee placed east of the lake by the clubhouse; the hole plays over the lake and down between the lakes to the green by the road, a guess.
unsure.10: Par 3 over water to the green below the clubhouse; tee placed on the strip between the lakes.
